messages.subject: Re: ggplot upgrade problem with bar charts
parts:
You're missing a reproducible example. 

I'm guessing that it's related to stat="identity" in that it's plotting the data as it reads it, but that's just a guess. 


On Wed, Apr 10, 2013 at 3:54 PM, Prasad A. <prasad....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

I just updated ggplot from 0.8.x to 0.9.3 and find all my old scripts producing bar charts are now causing problems. See below where the 2nd chart shows the factors jumbled up, whereas the old chart (left) looks clean.  If this seems familiar to any of you, hope you can help.  The code is pretty simple. Am I missing something? Thanks for any help.

ggplot(p3data,aes(Iteration,Estimate,fill=Type)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values=colours)
